beispiel.1: Fresh snow overnight|The first footprints in the garden|Hats on, let’s go out|Who builds the biggest snowman?
beispiel.2: Made it to the top|And off we go!|Slid almost to the fence|One more run, please|Cocoa to warm up
beispiel.3: Who’s behind the mask?|The parade sets off|Confetti everywhere
beispiel.4: The dice are ready|Who wins this time?|Lost by a whisker|Rematch on Sunday
beispiel.5: Outside again at last|The first blossoms|Jackets off, sun on|Picnic on the blanket|Barefoot in the grass
beispiel.6: Where did the bunny hide them?|One in the flower bed!|The basket is filling up
beispiel.7: Helmets on, saddles up|A short break on the path|The lake is sparkling ahead|Feet in the water
beispiel.8: Counting candles|One big puff|Make a wish!|The first slice|Crumbs on the plate
beispiel.9: A day by the water|Skimming stones|Stayed until the evening
beispiel.10: Holidays at last!|The first wave|Collecting shells|Ice cream with a sea view
beispiel.11: The plan is set|Dig, dig, dig|The moat holds|Almost done|Our castle!
beispiel.12: The sun goes for a swim|Everyone looks out to sea|Five more minutes
beispiel.13: The school cone is almost as big as you|In front of the school gate|The first seat in the classroom|Made it: the first day!
beispiel.14: Off into the woods|Who finds the thickest tree?|Only look at the mushrooms|A rest on the tree trunk|Back with full pockets
beispiel.15: The wind is perfect|Higher, higher!|It’s flying!
beispiel.16: Which pumpkin will it be?|First, hollow it out|Spooky or funny?|Ready to glow
beispiel.17: A giant pile of leaves|Watch out, attack!|Leaves in the hood|Everyone lying in the leaves|Again from the start
beispiel.18: The lanterns are finished|Lantern, lantern …|Through the dark street
beispiel.19: Rolling out the dough|Stars, hearts, moons|Just one little nibble|The first tray is done
beispiel.20: Between the stalls|It smells of roasted almonds|One ride on the carousel|Warm hands around the mug|Lights above the square
beispiel.21: Skates on|First wobbly lap|Hand in hand across the ice
beispiel.22: A tunnel of light|Everything sparkles|Cold noses, warm hearts|The most beautiful tree in the park
beispiel.23: The tree is up|First the fairy lights|Bauble by bauble|Who gets to put the star on top?|Lights on!
beispiel.24: Christmas Eve at last|All together under the tree|Thank you for this wonderful year

start.seitentitel: Your Advent Calendar – a photo every day of Advent

satz.tueren: The classic: 24 cardboard doors that swing open – behind them waits the photo of the day.
satz.girlande: Fir garlands with 24 Christmas baubles. Each opened bauble shows its photo as if through curved glass.
satz.kranz: An Advent wreath with 24 candles: one more burns every day, and the room gets brighter.
satz.rubbellos: A scratch card every day. Scratch off the silver foil with your finger – the photo is underneath.
satz.fotoleine: Envelopes on the string of lights – inside, an instant photo that develops before your eyes.
satz.stories: Every day is a little story of several photos, tapped through like on a phone.
satz.schneekugel: Shake until the snow settles – then the photo appears in the globe.
satz.baum: Spin a 3D Christmas tree with your finger until the glowing bauble of the day appears.
satz.geschenk: Pull open the bow, tear off the paper – and the photo rises out of the box with confetti.
satz.nuss: A golden nut every day: pull the lever until it cracks and a photo rolls out.
satz.sterne: Connect the numbered stars with your finger until the constellation lights up and shows the photo.
satz.schneemann: Roll a different figure from snowballs every day – but watch out for warm spots. The finished figure holds the photo.
